header: This ingests / re-reads circulars with ONLINE GEMINI VISION OCR (gemini-3.5-flash). It replaces poor text and corrupted tables with high-fidelity verbatim text, recalculates Google embeddings, and atomically updates PostgreSQL circular_chunks. USAGE: npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/reingest-circulars-gemini.ts npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/reingest-circulars-gemini.ts --ids 82,21 npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/reingest-circulars-gemini.ts --year 2024 npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/reingest-circulars-gemini.ts --dry-run SAFEGUARDS (I added them in the review of 7 Nov 2026; the first version had none of them):
* holiday-list circulars and health check-up roster circulars are SKIPPED, exactly as the upload route treats them (their body is deliberately not chunked: the facts live in structured tables);
* a page whose reading ended with the "reading incomplete" marker, or came back empty, is never cached and never saved: the circular is skipped and reported (use --allow-incomplete only knowingly);
* nothing is written when no text was read, or when the new text is under half the stored text (use --force knowingly);
* a circular that fails is reported and the run goes on; the exit code is 1 if any failed;
* "already done" means a .committed flag written AFTER the commit (a rolled-back run is not counted as done);
* stored text is embedded as a DOCUMENT, as the upload route now does (queries are the only query-type embeddings).
